newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock index starts at another fresh high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock index starts at another fresh high.

text.p: Madrid's general stock index opened 4.45 points higher, or 0.85 percent, to 530.30 on Tuesday setting another all-time high after strong gains on Wall Street yesterday and domestic optimism, dealers said.
At 0820 GMT the Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 0.7 percent to 6,101.70.
Dealers said prospects for new falls in Spanish April inflation and likely subsequent cuts in the key money rate were underpinning gains. April CPI is due on May 14.
